Messages.Author: Pepijn
Messages.Body:
I was wondering (it came up recently) what happens if my minion
inflicts more damage at close range by strikes as my opponent does,
but he has played a Carrion Crows. In total I get more damage. Can I
still play disarm?

I would say yes, since the carrion crows inflict the damage and not
the opposing vampire (as with if I strike with aggro damage at first
strike I still get damage from the carrion crows). Am I right in this
or totally wrong?

Grtz,

Pepijn
